name: Fujimiya Shizuma
source:
Vice President of Fujinomiya Eiga Co. He is like an older brother to Yusuke.

He discovered Yusuke's talent and encouraged him to join his own film company.

He is a man worth relying on.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=532785]Getchu[/url]]
